title: Words that stay with us
intro: Here are the words of women who have already had their readings and consultations.
ctaTitle: Perhaps the next story will be yours.
ctaText: If you feel it is time to understand yourself better, let’s start with a conversation.
seoTitle: Reviews | Елена Захарова — numerologist and coach for women
seoDescription: Client reviews of numerology readings and consultations with Елена Захарова.

items.review1:
The magic of numbers exists!

I ordered a reading from Елена and simply have to share!

This was not just a reading of my date of birth, but a real session of self-discovery. I absolutely loved everything: both the presentation and the depth of the information. Елена explained complex things in simple terms, helped me make sense of my personal hang-ups and gave me incredibly practical advice for the coming year.

My mind feels lighter, and I have a clear plan of action. This is the best gift I could give myself!

I recommend it to everyone looking for answers within themselves.
items.review2:
Елена, you are an amazing person!

My consultation with you became more than a reading of numbers — it was a real journey of self-discovery. You were able to explain and confirm many things I had felt intuitively.

I received answers to questions that had been on my mind for a long time: what my talents are, why some tasks come easily while others bring up resistance, and where best to direct my energy.

After the consultation, I felt more confident in myself and my possibilities. As if someone had switched on a light where there used to be doubt.

Thank you for your professionalism, sincerity and ability to inspire people to make changes!
items.review3:
Елена, thank you so much for the consultation!

Very precise, insightful and easy to understand. Many observations were spot on and helped me look at my life in a completely different way.

After talking with you, I felt more confident, had greater clarity and understood my strengths better. I can feel that you put your heart into your work and truly want to help people.

I definitely recommend it to anyone who wants to get to know themselves better and find answers to important questions.
items.review4:
Елена, thank you for the consultation!

To be honest, I was cautious about numerology, but after talking with you, many things fell into place. The reading of my financial life was particularly valuable to me.

You helped me see strengths I had previously underestimated and explained where I was limiting my own growth.

After the consultation, I reconsidered some decisions, began acting more confidently and stopped doubting my abilities.

I highly recommend Елена to anyone who wants to understand themselves better and fulfil their potential. Thank you for your professionalism and in-depth approach!
items.review5:
Thank you so much, Елена, for such an insightful reading!

Honestly, so much resonated with me and made me think. Especially the parts about fears, relationships and my inner state — it was as if I could see myself from the outside.

After the reading, I felt much calmer and understood what really matters to work on in order to build harmonious relationships without losing myself.

So heartfelt, gentle and yet profound.
items.review6:
Honestly… I never expected it to go so deep.

I went out of curiosity, but ended up hearing more about myself than I understand on my own. Some things resonated so strongly they gave me goosebumps.

I felt calmer inside somehow. There was a sense that nothing is accidental. And now I know where to go.

Елена, thank you so much. You really are wonderful! Our guide to a world of meaning and understanding.

I am so glad I had this reading.
items.review7: Thank you so much! This really matches my inner sense of what to strive for and where to go. You confirmed my thoughts and that I am thinking in the right direction.
items.review8:
And I also have a third eye 😅

I actually thought of you today and was going to write that the readings are really great. Absolutely spot on.
